canonical_text:
DeepSeek reportedly raised about RMB 100 billion ($15 billion), with Tencent and CATL among the biggest investors.

The payoff to watch: stronger models, reliable API capacity, and continued open-weight releases. That last part is what could make this investment useful far beyond DeepSeek's own products.
